claims: Geneva is surrounded by the Alps.
Geneva has a population of over 200,000.
Geneva hosts the International Red Cross.
Jet d'Eau is a fountain in Lake Geneva.
Geneva's Old Town (Vieille Ville) is home to St. Peter's Cathedral.
The Palace of Nations is the European United Nations headquarters.
The Reformation Wall is a monument in the Parc des Bastions.
The Flower Clock (L'horloge fleurie) is a tribute to Genevan watchmakers.
Geneva is the most populous French-speaking city in Switzerland.
French is the official language of Geneva.
English is widely used in Geneva due to international organizations
